spell.zminedarkspells.to_dark_side.guide: Sends you to dark side of the world, nobody can kill you.
spell.zminedarkspells.dark_point.guide: Create a Dark Point in the world.
spell.zminedarkspells.dark_point_remover: Remove Dark Point from the world.
spell.zminedarkspells.dark_swap.guide: Teleports entity from Dark Point to you and you to Dark Point.
spell.zminedarkspells.dark_strike.guide: Create Dark Shard on Dark Point and remove blocks radius 20.
spell.zminedarkspells.dark_point_reloade: Reloads Dark Points on the world.
spell.zminedarkspells.dark_teleport.guid: Teleports you any Dark Point on the world.
ui.dark_spells.dark_strike: Dark will take part of the world.
ui.dark_spells.dark_swap: Swaps entity from Dark Point to you.
ui.dark_spells.dark_sword: Swaps entity from Dark Point to you.
